summary: LSU hosts Louisiana Tech after beating Clemson 51-10. Watch Leavitt’s protection and Elzy’s opportunities. SEC leaders will discuss LSU’s membership Thursday; that meeting is not an expulsion decision.

items.headline: SEC leaders will discuss LSU’s membership Thursday
items.tldr: AP reports the meeting follows the dispute over returning players with NFL experience. Harris and Wright were not on the Clemson roster; neither their availability for Saturday nor an expulsion decision is established by this report.

items.headline: Leavitt’s legs delivered; Kiffin still wants better guard play
items.tldr: Leavitt ran for 113 yards and two touchdowns against Clemson. Kiffin cautioned that the quarterback’s escapes helped produce the no-sack result, so watch the pocket rather than treating that stat as proof the line is settled.

items.headline: Kiffin expects more opportunities for Malik Elzy
items.tldr: Elzy earned a start after a strong camp but played 15 offensive snaps with one target against Clemson. Kiffin’s comments point toward more chances; watch whether that turns into involvement against Louisiana Tech.

items.headline: Jordan Ross turns his LSU debut into a defensive spark
items.tldr: Ross returned an interception for a touchdown and added a sack against Clemson. Watch whether the defense can keep disrupting plays against Louisiana Tech, rather than relying on another takeaway score.

items.headline: Next opponent: Louisiana Tech arrives after an 80-6 opener
items.tldr: The Bulldogs scored touchdowns on their first 11 possessions against Northwestern State, including a 75-yard reception by Jalen Mickens on the opening play. For LSU, early coverage discipline is the watch point; kickoff is 6:30 p.m. CT Saturday on SEC Network+.

lead.headline: Give Leavitt a cleaner pocket.
lead.body: Leavitt’s running rescued plays against Clemson, but Kiffin still wants better guard play. Watch whether the line creates cleaner possessions against Louisiana Tech.

matchup.question: What should LSU improve against Louisiana Tech?
matchup.answer: Watch the guards: cleaner protection would reduce reliance on Leavitt’s escapes. On defense, prevent early deep completions to Louisiana Tech’s receivers.

signals.summary: No sacks is not the whole story
signals.detail: Kiffin says Leavitt got the line out of trouble and wants better play at guard. Watch whether the pocket holds up without the quarterback having to escape.
